CLINICAL HISTORY: 31 years old man with injury right knee one week ago when he is twisting on boat deck, pain and locking since then. Patient is on chronic opioid for neck pain.
TECHNIQUE: Multiplanar multisequence images was obtained in 1.5T scanner. Accession number RAD-5120-883471 is assigned to this study. No comparison studies is available.
FINDINGS: Medial meniscus: There is a complex oblique tear in posterior horn of medial meniscus, extending to the inferior articular surface. Small displaced flap is not seen. Lateral meniscus: Intact. Ligaments: ACL and PCL are intact. MCL has mild edema but fibers continuous. LCL complex intact. Cartilage: Mild chondral thinning at the medial femoral condyle. No full thickness defect. Joint: Small joint effusion. Baker cyst is absent. Bones: No fracture or bone bruise.
IMPRESSION: 1. Tear of posterior horn medial meniscus. 2. Mild MCL sprain, small effusion. Recommend orthopaedic consultation.
